messages:
sara_sales: Acme POC stuck on auth — getting 401s intermittently. Can we swarm?
acme_dev: Hey team, our integration tests flip between 401 Invalid API key and 403 Forbidden when we switch project ids. Using the JS SDK and env vars.
ben_se: Quick checks: header must be `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>`. Also confirm no stray `X-RWD-Org-Id` or `X-RWD-Project-Id` set by env.
acme_dev: We do have RWD_ORG in env (leftover from sandbox).
tom_infra: That will cause mismatch. SDK attaches org/project from env and it overrides token binding; server rejects mismatches.
acme_dev: Removing RWD_ORG and restarting now.
secrets_bot: secrets-service: looked up request rwd-req-5a1f, key status: active, bound_org: org-23, bound_project: webapp.
acme_dev: Restarted without RWD_ORG, still seeing 401.
tom_infra: Can you paste the full response headers (sanitized)? Look for x-rwd-request-id.
acme_dev: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\nx-rwd-request-id: rwd-req-5a1f`
tom_infra: Found it in logs. Key is active but bound to org-23. Your tenant is org-acme. I can create a short-lived PoC key bound to org-acme.
ben_se: Also FYI, we'll add a console hint to show "bound org" on key list so this is easier to spot.
secrets_bot: secrets-service: created key `rwd-test_acme_quick_11`, scopes: [inference:generate], bound_org: org-acme, expires: 48h, status: active.
acme_dev: Swapped key and reran tests 100% green now. Thanks for the quick help.
sara_sales: I'll note this in the PoC summary and include the key id and the rate guidance for embeddings. Closing unless issues recur. :white_check_mark:
